direct_fit: same-song mixture or enough synchronized stems to sum a mixture
aligned MIDI, note, pitch, or F0 truth

datasets.name: URMP
datasets.truth: MIDI score plus frame-level and note-level pitch annotations
datasets.download_note: The official site routes the full 12.5 GB package through dataset download registration rather than a stable direct archive URL.
datasets.evidence: Official page and paper describe 44 multi-instrument pieces with individual audio tracks, assembled mixtures, MIDI scores, and annotations.

datasets.name: Bach10
datasets.truth: pitch and note transcriptions plus audio-score alignment
datasets.evidence: URMP survey table and text describe 10 Bach chorale multitrack recordings with pitch/note transcription and audio-score alignment.

datasets.name: TRIOS
datasets.truth: MIDI transcriptions
datasets.evidence: URMP survey table and text describe 5 multitrack trio recordings with MIDI transcriptions.

datasets.name: MIREX Woodwind Quintet
datasets.truth: note annotations
datasets.evidence: URMP survey describes a woodwind quintet with individual recordings and note annotations, with only a short public excerpt.

datasets.name: PHENICX-Anechoic
datasets.truth: note annotations
datasets.evidence: URMP survey describes four anechoic orchestral pieces with 8-10 isolated parts each and denoised note annotations.

datasets.name: Ensemble Expressive Performance
datasets.truth: string-quartet note annotations plus per-player audio/contact-microphone tracks
datasets.download_note: The URMP survey lists EEP as a 23-piece string-quartet dataset with audio, note annotations, and bow motion-capture data. Current public archive layout and licensing still need verification, so this repository supports a prepared manifest path instead of a hard-coded downloader.
datasets.evidence: URMP survey table describes Ensemble Expressive Performance as 23 string-quartet pieces with audio, note annotations, and bow MoCap; the prepared-multitrack gate can evaluate such data once local source audio and note CSVs are mapped into manifest.json.

datasets.name: MusicNet
datasets.truth: temporal note and instrument labels
datasets.download_note: Open Zenodo archive contains 11.1 GB of WAV audio plus CSV labels and reference MIDI files; it has no isolated stems.
datasets.evidence: Zenodo record describes 330 freely licensed classical recordings with over 1M note labels including precise time, instrument, and note, but not separated same-song source tracks.

datasets.name: MulTTiPop
datasets.truth: warped multitrack MIDI aligned to commercial-pop audio segments
datasets.download_note: The released dataset contains aligned multitrack MIDI plus metadata with YouTube IDs/timestamps for the corresponding audio, not isolated audio stems.
datasets.evidence: Official preview and paper describe 572 real pop audio segments with associated aligned multitrack MIDI; audio is not released as isolated stems.

datasets.name: Slakh2100
datasets.truth: rendered stems and mixtures generated from source-separated MIDI tracks
datasets.download_note: The official page hosts the Slakh2100 release; audio is rendered from MIDI with virtual instruments, not real recorded performances.
datasets.evidence: Paper describes 2100 train/validation/test songs, 145 hours of mixtures, separated stems, accompanying MIDI files, and every mixture containing piano, bass, guitar, and drums.

datasets.name: ChoralSynth
datasets.truth: synthetic voice tracks plus score MusicXML and MIDI with all voices
datasets.download_note: The released data contains MP3 voice tracks and score files; audio is generated with singing synthesis rather than live choir recording.
datasets.evidence: Paper describes 20 choral pieces, each with a MusicXML score, MIDI with all voices, one audio track per voice, beat positions, and metadata; it explicitly presents the dataset as synthetic choral singing data.

datasets.name: CocoChorales
datasets.truth: synthetic chamber ensemble stems, mixtures, MIDI, note expression, F0, and synthesis-parameter annotations
datasets.download_note: The dataset is generated by the Chamber Ensemble Generator using Coconet and MIDI-DDSP trained on URMP; it is useful for large stem/MIDI coverage but is not real recorded audio.
datasets.evidence: Paper describes 240,000 generated chamber-ensemble performances across string, brass, woodwind, and random ensembles, with audio mixtures, stems, MIDI, note-level performance attributes, F0 curves, loudness, and synthesis parameters.

datasets.name: SynthSOD
datasets.truth: synthesized orchestra/ensemble close-mic stems plus aligned note text from source MIDI
datasets.download_note: Zenodo hosts a 45 GB full SynthSOD audio archive plus a 2 GB sample archive; aligned score text is a separate 16.4 MB Zenodo release covering about 85% of the songs. Audio is synthesized with BBC Symphony Orchestra sounds, not live recorded.
datasets.evidence: Paper describes a 47+ hour synthesized orchestral multitrack dataset from 596 selected SOD MIDI files, with close-mic source signals; Zenodo documents SynthSOD-data/<song>/Close Mic FLAC stems, metadata JSON, and a separate aligned-score release with start/end time, MIDI pitch, and MIDI instrument for each note.

datasets.name: Vocal Ensemble F0 Aggregate
datasets.truth: per-singer F0 annotations for vocal quartet mixtures
datasets.download_note: The companion repository provides data-generation code and trained models. The 20+ real-song Barbershop Quartet and Bach Chorale source audio comes from PG Music commercial releases, so this repository supports a local prepared mtracks_info.json layout rather than downloading audio.
datasets.evidence: ISMIR 2020 paper describes an aggregate of multi-track vocal datasets with F0 annotations, including 22 Barbershop Quartet songs and 26 Bach Chorales with individual quartet voices; companion setup code generates mixture WAV files plus mtracks_info.json from per-voice F0 annotations, and this harness can require source_audio_files/source_audio_folder entries to sum the voice tracks before analysis.

datasets.name: POP909
datasets.truth: aligned MIDI plus beat, key, and chord annotations
datasets.evidence: Paper describes aligned MIDI and musical annotations for pop songs, but not per-instrument audio stems.

datasets.name: MAESTRO
datasets.truth: aligned piano MIDI with velocities and pedal controls
datasets.download_note: Official v3.0.0 archive is about 101 GB compressed and 120 GB uncompressed; MIDI-only and metadata-only downloads are also available.
datasets.evidence: Official page describes 1,276 performances, 198.7 hours of paired piano WAV/MIDI data, about 3 ms alignment, metadata CSV/JSON, and over 7M notes.

datasets.name: IDMT-SMT-Bass-Single-Track
datasets.truth: bass note onset, offset, MIDI pitch, string, fret, plucking style, and expression style annotations
datasets.download_note: The test-idmt-bass-lines-samples target downloads the 20.5 MB ZIP, prepares stable expression-style NO note clips into build/idmt_bass_lines_samples, and runs the shared isolated-bass real-note analyzer gate. The current default prepares 640 clips and detects 625/640.
datasets.evidence: Fraunhofer and Zenodo describe 17 real electric-bass lines with note-level onset, offset, pitch, string, fret, plucking-style, and expression-style annotations; the ZIP contains 17 WAV files plus note CSV/XML annotations.

datasets.name: IDMT-SMT-Guitar
datasets.truth: guitar note onset, offset, MIDI pitch, string, fret, excitation style, and expression style annotations
datasets.download_note: The optional test-idmt-guitar-samples target downloads the 1.3 GB ZIP, prepares stable monophonic non-dead-note clips into build/idmt_guitar_samples, and runs the shared isolated-guitar real-note analyzer gate.
datasets.evidence: Zenodo describes IDMT-SMT-Guitar as a real guitar dataset with isolated recordings and XML annotations. The repository importer reads XML note events with onset, offset, pitch, string, fret, excitation style, and expression style, then keeps monophonic chromatic note snippets as detector evidence.

datasets.name: IDMT-SMT-Drums
datasets.truth: manual kick drum, snare drum, and hi-hat onset annotations in SVL/XML frame-point files
datasets.download_note: The test-idmt-drums-samples target downloads the 287.1 MB ZIP, prepares 300 annotated hit windows each for kick, snare, and hi-hat into build/idmt_drums_samples, and runs the shared drum analyzer gate with those three classes required.
datasets.evidence: Fraunhofer describes IDMT-SMT-Drums as 608 mono 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV files with 104 polyphonic drum loops, per-loop training files for kick drum, snare drum, and hi-hat, and manually annotated onsets in XML/SVL; Zenodo hosts the 287.1 MB V2 ZIP.

datasets.name: GuitarSet
datasets.truth: per-string MIDI-note annotations, pitch contours, chords, beats, and styles
datasets.evidence: Official page and Zenodo record describe 360 hexaphonic guitar excerpts with per-string audio, microphone audio, JAMS note/chord/fret annotations, and rich time-aligned metadata.

datasets.name: Guitar-TECHS
datasets.truth: synchronized per-string MIDI labels for electric-guitar single notes, techniques, chords, scales, and musical excerpts
datasets.download_note: The optional test-guitar-techs-samples target downloads the smaller P1/P2 single-note ZIPs, prepares DI and amplifier-mic note excerpts, and keeps the larger techniques/chords/scales/music archives out of normal smoke tests. The current single-note default prep yields 547 tested clips after 11 pitch-reference skips. The optional test-guitar-techs-chord-samples target downloads the P1/P2 chord ZIPs and now uses the full current 7016-clip chord-window sweep by default.
datasets.evidence: Official project and Zenodo pages describe 3,732 electric-guitar recordings across single notes, techniques, chords, scales, and excerpts, captured from DI, amplifier microphone, egocentric, and exocentric perspectives with synchronized MIDI labels; this repository gates the single-note subset through the shared real-note analyzer test, with 547/547 prepared clips detected in isolated-guitar mode, and gates the P1/P2 chord subset through the isolated-guitar note/chord harness, with 7016 prepared chord clips and 7788 analyzer windows.

datasets.name: Guitar Chord Mix
datasets.truth: WAV clips paired with JAMS note_midi annotations, one note annotation per guitar string
datasets.download_note: The optional test-guitar-chord-mix-samples target downloads all currently matched WAV/JAMS chord clips into build/guitar_chord_mix_samples, writes a GuitarSet-shaped manifest, and runs the isolated-guitar note/chord harness. The default bound is GUITAR_CHORD_MIX_LIMIT=0, which covered 500 matched pairs in the current public tree; set a positive limit for a smaller local tuning loop.
datasets.evidence: The dataset card describes a soundfolder release of guitar chord clips with WAV audio and JAMS annotations, assembled from GuitarSet, Guitar-TECHS, EGFxSet, Isolated Guitar Chords, SFZ, and DEMAND sources; each clip includes six note_midi annotations, one per string.

datasets.name: Vocadito
datasets.truth: frame-level F0 plus two trained-musician note annotation versions for solo monophonic vocals
datasets.download_note: The test-vocadito-samples target downloads the 58.5 MB ZIP, prepares stable near-chromatic A1 note clips into build/vocadito_samples, and runs the shared isolated-vocal real-note analyzer gate. The current default prepares 370 clips and detects 368/370.
datasets.evidence: Zenodo describes 40 short solo monophonic singing excerpts recorded in real-world conditions, with trained-musician frame-level F0 annotations, two note annotation versions, lyrics, and language metadata; the README inside the ZIP documents note CSV rows as start time, pitch in Hz, and duration.

datasets.name: GAPS
datasets.truth: high-resolution note-level MIDI alignments
datasets.download_note: Hugging Face hosts audio, MIDI, MusicXML, match, sync-point, and metadata folders. The optional test-gaps-guitar-samples target prefilters the public match-file tree, downloads a bounded subset of available aligned performances into build/gaps_guitar_samples, parses match files into a GuitarSet-shaped manifest, and runs the isolated-guitar note/chord harness.
datasets.evidence: Dataset card and paper describe 300 solo classical-guitar performances, about 14 hours of real audio, audio-score aligned pairs, and high-resolution note-level MIDI alignments; the Hugging Face tree exposes audio, MIDI, MusicXML, match files, sync points, and metadata.

datasets.name: E-GMD
datasets.truth: paired drum MIDI and human velocity annotations
datasets.download_note: Official v1.0.0 archive is about 90 GB compressed and 132 GB uncompressed; MIDI-only and metadata-only downloads are also available.
datasets.evidence: Official page describes 45,537 audio/MIDI recordings, 444.5 hours, 43 drum kits, MIDI annotations with human velocity, and about 2 ms alignment.

datasets.name: MedleyDB
datasets.truth: melody F0 and instrument activation annotations
datasets.download_note: Audio files are on restricted Zenodo records with quick permission request; annotations and metadata are public on GitHub.
datasets.evidence: Official page describes 196 multitracks total, with melody F0 annotations and instrument activations. The analyzer gate sums local stems and checks melody pitch recall, but this still is not full MIDI/note truth for every source.

datasets.name: MUSDB18
datasets.truth: four-stem source labels
datasets.download_note: The compressed MUSDB18 release is about 4.4 GB and requires Zenodo access approval for academic use; MUSDB18-HQ is an equivalent uncompressed WAV release.
datasets.evidence: Official page describes 150 full-length tracks with mixture, drums, bass, vocals, and other stems; the mixture corresponds to the sum of the source stems, but there is no MIDI/note truth.

datasets.name: MoisesDB
datasets.truth: hierarchical audio stems
datasets.evidence: Paper describes 240 tracks with individual audio sources in a hierarchical stem taxonomy, but no MIDI/note truth.

datasets.name: The Spheres Dataset
datasets.truth: isolated orchestral stems, microphone signals, stereo/main mixes, room impulse responses, scales, and solo excerpts
datasets.download_note: The paper describes a public Zenodo release with two full orchestral works plus chromatic scales and solo excerpts; it does not describe full MIDI/note ground truth for the pieces.
datasets.evidence: Paper describes over one hour of real orchestral multitrack recordings, 23 microphones, isolated instrument/part recordings, derived realistic mixes, and stems whose sum equals the main mixture; it is too small and lacks full note/MIDI truth for the 20-song detector gate.
